notes.title: Download the DEMO now!
notes.content:
[b]Download and try the DEMO now![/b]

BEWARE, all players and competitions will be reset prior to the final release so come in to get a taster and provide feedback, but don't get too attached to your superstar players!

Blackout Football Manager is game made with love by a tiny team. It's not AAA (yet ːsteamhappyː) but we're constantly improving and can't wait to try out some of the more fun and exciting ideas we have in store. 

Enjoy!
